rule_summary: Different tax software products (TurboTax, Wealthsimple Tax, UFile) implement their own interview flows over the same underlying federal and Québec forms. A credit or question shown by one product and not another usually means the item is surfaced differently (asked explicitly, computed automatically, gated behind an earlier answer, or not separately shown) — it does NOT by itself mean one product is wrong. To resolve a discrepancy, identify the underlying form/line/credit (e.g. a Québec solidarity or living-alone credit, or a Schedule K premium), then compare the GENERATED federal and provincial forms across products rather than the interview screens.
uncertainty_notes: Software UIs and interview flows change frequently and are NOT an official source — never declare a product correct without inspecting the generated forms.
Software help pages rank low in the source policy; ground the tax conclusion in CRA/Revenu Québec, not the vendor.
